import numpy as np

def build_method(params, context):
    lower = np.asarray(context.lower, dtype=float).ravel()
    upper = np.asarray(context.upper, dtype=float).ravel()
    lo = np.log(lower)
    hi = np.log(upper)
    p = int(context.n_params)
    sigma = float(context.noise_std)
    iters = int(params.get('iters', 30))
    nstart = int(params.get('multistart', 3))
    h = float(params.get('fd_step', 1e-4))
    budget = int(params.get('max_calls', 2800000))
    seed = int(params.get('seed', 0))
    n_rec = int(params.get('n_recovery', 20))
    abs_tol = 1e-6
    cost_tol = 1e-8
    try:
        from scipy.stats import chi2
        q99 = float(chi2.ppf(0.99, 80 - p))
        med76 = float(chi2.ppf(0.5, 80 - p))
    except Exception:
        q99 = 107.6
        med76 = 75.3

    class BoxLM:
        def __init__(self):
            self.transpose = False
            self.calls = 0
            self.predict_calls = 0
            self.row_offset = 0
            self.layout_ok = False
            self.solver_pass = False

        def fwd(self, th_log):
            th_log = np.atleast_2d(th_log)
            self.calls += len(th_log)
            F = np.asarray(context.forward(np.exp(th_log)), dtype=float).reshape(len(th_log), -1)
            if self.transpose:
                m = F.shape[1]
                F = F.reshape(len(th_log), 4, m // 4).transpose(0, 2, 1).reshape(len(th_log), m)
            return F

        def _solve(self, X, seed_base, row_base):
            n, m = X.shape
            center = np.asarray(context.prior_center(), dtype=float).ravel()
            out = np.tile(center, (n, 1))
            sse = np.full(n, np.nan)
            nonfinite = np.zeros(n, bool)
            nonconv = np.zeros(n, bool)
            stalled = np.zeros(n, bool)
            bstuck = np.zeros(n, bool)
            disagree = np.zeros(n, bool)
            bfall = np.zeros(n, bool)
            cond = np.full(n, np.nan)
            fsd = np.full((n, p), np.nan)
            worst_case = nstart * (1 + iters * (p + 5))
            calls0 = self.calls
            for i in range(n):
                if self.calls + worst_case > budget:
                    bfall[i] = True
                    continue
                rng = np.random.default_rng([seed_base, row_base + i])
                th = np.log(rng.uniform(lower, upper, size=(nstart, p)))
                lam = np.full(nstart, 1e-2)
                obs = X[i]
                F = self.fwd(th)
                r = (obs - F) / sigma
                cost = (r ** 2).sum(1)
                last_step = np.zeros(nstart)
                last_dcost = np.zeros(nstart)
                last_acc = np.ones(nstart, bool)
                Jlast = None
                for it in range(iters):
                    step = np.where(th + h <= hi, h, -h)
                    pert = np.repeat(th[:, None, :], p, axis=1)
                    for j in range(p):
                        pert[:, j, j] += step[:, j]
                    Fp = self.fwd(pert.reshape(-1, p)).reshape(nstart, p, m)
                    J = (Fp - F[:, None, :]) / (step[:, :, None] * sigma)
                    Jlast = J
                    for s in range(nstart):
                        if not np.isfinite(cost[s]):
                            continue
                        Js = J[s].T
                        if not np.all(np.isfinite(Js)):
                            cost[s] = np.nan
                            continue
                        g = Js.T @ r[s]
                        H = Js.T @ Js
                        D = np.diag(np.diag(H)) + 1e-12 * np.eye(p)
                        accepted = False
                        for _ in range(5):
                            try:
                                d = np.linalg.solve(H + lam[s] * D, g)
                            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                                lam[s] *= 10.0
                                continue
                            th_new = np.clip(th[s] + d, lo, hi)
                            F_new = self.fwd(th_new)[0]
                            r_new = (obs - F_new) / sigma
                            c_new = float((r_new ** 2).sum())
                            if np.isfinite(c_new) and c_new <= cost[s]:
                                last_step[s] = float(np.abs(th_new - th[s]).max())
                                last_dcost[s] = float((cost[s] - c_new) / max(cost[s], 1e-12))
                                th[s] = th_new
                                F[s] = F_new
                                r[s] = r_new
                                cost[s] = c_new
                                lam[s] = max(lam[s] / 3.0, 1e-9)
                                accepted = True
                                break
                            lam[s] *= 4.0
                        last_acc[s] = accepted
                        if not accepted:
                            last_step[s] = 0.0
                            last_dcost[s] = 0.0
                ok = np.isfinite(cost)
                if not ok.any():
                    nonfinite[i] = True
                    continue
                best = int(np.argmin(np.where(ok, cost, np.inf)))
                kb = np.exp(th[best])
                out[i] = kb
                sse[i] = cost[best]
                nonconv[i] = bool(last_step[best] > abs_tol and last_dcost[best] > cost_tol)
                stalled[i] = bool(not last_acc[best])
                bstuck[i] = bool((np.abs(th[best] - lo) < abs_tol).any() or (np.abs(th[best] - hi) < abs_tol).any())
                others = np.exp(th[ok])
                disagree[i] = bool((np.abs(others - kb) / kb > 0.01).any())
                if Jlast is not None and np.all(np.isfinite(Jlast[best])):
                    Hb = Jlast[best] @ Jlast[best].T
                    try:
                        sv = np.linalg.svd(Hb, compute_uv=False)
                        cond[i] = float(sv.max() / max(sv.min(), 1e-300))
                        fsd[i] = np.sqrt(np.clip(np.diag(np.linalg.pinv(Hb)), 0, None))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            fin = sse[np.isfinite(sse)]
            processed = int(n - bfall.sum())
            stats = {
                'n_rows': int(n),
                'n_obs': int(m),
                'forward_calls': int(self.calls - calls0),
                'calls_per_processed_row': float((self.calls - calls0) / max(processed, 1)),
                'n_nonfinite': int(nonfinite.sum()),
                'n_nonconverged_abs_step_and_cost': int(nonconv.sum()),
                'n_stalled_no_accepted_step_final_iter': int(stalled.sum()),
                'n_conv_not_stalled': int(((~nonconv) & (~stalled)).sum()),
                'n_conv_stalled': int(((~nonconv) & stalled).sum()),
                'n_nonconv_not_stalled': int((nonconv & (~stalled)).sum()),
                'n_nonconv_stalled': int((nonconv & stalled).sum()),
                'n_bound_stuck': int(bstuck.sum()),
                'n_budget_fallback': int(bfall.sum()),
                'frac_start_disagree_gt_1pct': float(disagree.sum() / max(processed, 1)),
                'sse_expected_chi2_df': int(80 - p),
                'chi2_76_median_ref': med76,
                'sse_mean': float(fin.mean()) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_median': float(np.median(fin)) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_p05': float(np.percentile(fin, 5)) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_p95': float(np.percentile(fin, 95)) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_max': float(fin.max()) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_q99_threshold': q99,
                'n_sse_above_q99': int((fin > q99).sum()),
                'sse_median_bound_stuck': float(np.median(sse[bstuck & np.isfinite(sse)])) if (bstuck & np.isfinite(sse)).any() else None,
                'sse_median_not_bound_stuck': float(np.median(sse[(~bstuck) & np.isfinite(sse)])) if ((~bstuck) & np.isfinite(sse)).any() else None,
                'local_fisher_sd_logk_median_per_target': [float(np.nanmedian(fsd[:, j])) if np.isfinite(fsd[:, j]).any() else None for j in range(p)],
                'local_fisher_cond_median': float(np.nanmedian(cond)) if np.isfinite(cond).any() else None,
                'local_fisher_note': 'local sensitivity at last Jacobian of best start; not a global identifiability guarantee',
            }
            per_row = {'sse': sse, 'bound_stuck': bstuck, 'disagree': disagree, 'nonconv': nonconv, 'stalled': stalled, 'budget_fallback': bfall, 'nonfinite': nonfinite}
            return out, stats, per_row

        def fit(self, X, y):
            X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)
            y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
            col_mean = float(np.abs(X.mean(0)).max())
            col_std = float(np.abs(X.std(0) - 1.0).max())
            if col_mean < 1e-3 and col_std < 1e-3:
                raise RuntimeError('PHYSICS_ABORT X appears standardised')
            n = int(min(20, len(y)))
            if (y[:n] < lower - 1e-9).any() or (y[:n] > upper + 1e-9).any():
                raise RuntimeError('PHYSICS_ABORT training y not in raw k bounds')
            m = int(X.shape[1])
            self.transpose = False
            a = float((((X[:n] - self.fwd(np.log(y[:n]))) / sigma) ** 2).sum(1).mean())
            b = float('inf')
            if m % 4 == 0:
                self.transpose = True
                b = float((((X[:n] - self.fwd(np.log(y[:n]))) / sigma) ** 2).sum(1).mean())
            self.transpose = bool(b < a)
            best_sse = min(a, b)
            self.layout_ok = bool(abs(best_sse - m) < 12.0)
            self.layout_report = {'sse_mean_as_returned': a, 'sse_mean_transposed': b if np.isfinite(b) else None, 'transpose_used': self.transpose, 'layout_sse_mean': best_sse, 'layout_ok_rule': '|min_sse_mean - n_obs| < 12 over 20 rows', 'layout_ok': self.layout_ok, 'x_col_mean_absmax': col_mean, 'x_col_std_dev_from_1_max': col_std, 'layout_calls': int(self.calls)}
            print('PHYSICS_LAYOUT_REPORT', self.layout_report)
            nr = int(min(n_rec, len(y)))
            rec, st, pr = self._solve(X[:nr], seed + 1000000, 0)
            yt = y[:nr]
            rel = float(np.linalg.norm(rec - yt) / max(np.linalg.norm(yt), 1e-12))
            per_target = [float(np.linalg.norm(rec[:, j] - yt[:, j]) / max(np.linalg.norm(yt[:, j]), 1e-12)) for j in range(p)]
            row_rel = np.linalg.norm(rec - yt, axis=1) / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(yt, axis=1), 1e-12)
            c_rel = rel < 0.10
            c_med = (st['sse_median'] is not None) and (abs(st['sse_median'] - med76) < 10.0)
            c_q99 = st['n_sse_above_q99'] <= 1
            c_dis = st['frac_start_disagree_gt_1pct'] <= 0.25
            self.solver_pass = bool(c_rel and c_med and c_q99 and c_dis and st['n_budget_fallback'] == 0)
            self.verification = {
                'n_recovery_rows': nr,
                'recovery_rel_l2_frobenius': rel,
                'recovery_rel_l2_per_target': per_target,
                'recovery_row_rel_median': float(np.median(row_rel)),
                'recovery_row_rel_max': float(row_rel.max()),
                'rule': 'rel_l2<0.10 and |sse_median-chi2_76 median|<10 and n_sse_above_q99<=1 and frac_disagree<=0.25 and no budget fallback',
                'pass_rel': bool(c_rel), 'pass_sse_median': bool(c_med), 'pass_q99': bool(c_q99), 'pass_disagree': bool(c_dis),
                'solver_pass': self.solver_pass,
                'seed_namespace': seed + 1000000,
                'solver_stats': st,
            }
            print('SOLVER_VERIFICATION', self.verification)
            return self

        def predict(self, X):
            X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)
            self.predict_calls += 1
            out, st, pr = self._solve(X, seed, self.row_offset)
            self.row_offset += len(X)
            val_sse_flag = (st['sse_median'] is not None) and (st['sse_median'] > med76 + 15.0)
            report = dict(st)
            report.update({
                'n_val': int(len(X)),
                'predict_calls': int(self.predict_calls),
                'row_offset_after': int(self.row_offset),
                'transpose_used': self.transpose,
                'layout_ok': self.layout_ok,
                'solver_pass': self.solver_pass,
                'total_forward_calls_arm': int(self.calls),
                'budget_cap': budget,
                'fd_step_log': h,
                'fd_at_bound': 'one-sided toward interior',
                'seed_scheme': 'default_rng([seed, global_row_offset + i])',
                'val_sse_median_mismatch_flag': bool(val_sse_flag),
                'val_sse_mismatch_rule': 'sse_median > chi2_76 median + 15 -> comparison claims uninformative',
                'facts': context.facts,
            })
            print('PHYSICS_LM_REPORT', report)
            self.report = report
            self.per_row = pr
            return out

    return BoxLM()

import numpy as np

def build_method(params, context):
    lower = np.asarray(context.lower, dtype=float).ravel()
    upper = np.asarray(context.upper, dtype=float).ravel()
    lo = np.log(lower)
    hi = np.log(upper)
    p = int(context.n_params)
    sigma = float(context.noise_std)
    iters = int(params.get('iters', 30))
    nstart = int(params.get('multistart', 3))
    h = float(params.get('fd_step', 1e-4))
    budget = int(params.get('max_calls', 2800000))
    seed = int(params.get('seed', 0))
    n_rec = int(params.get('n_recovery', 20))
    abs_tol = 1e-6
    cost_tol = 1e-8
    try:
        from scipy.stats import chi2
        q99 = float(chi2.ppf(0.99, 80 - p))
        med76 = float(chi2.ppf(0.5, 80 - p))
    except Exception:
        q99 = 107.6
        med76 = 75.3

    class BoxLM:
        def __init__(self):
            self.transpose = False
            self.calls = 0
            self.predict_calls = 0
            self.row_offset = 0
            self.layout_ok = False
            self.solver_pass = False

        def fwd(self, th_log):
            th_log = np.atleast_2d(th_log)
            self.calls += len(th_log)
            F = np.asarray(context.forward(np.exp(th_log)), dtype=float).reshape(len(th_log), -1)
            if self.transpose:
                m = F.shape[1]
                F = F.reshape(len(th_log), 4, m // 4).transpose(0, 2, 1).reshape(len(th_log), m)
            return F

        def _solve(self, X, seed_base, row_base):
            n, m = X.shape
            center = np.asarray(context.prior_center(), dtype=float).ravel()
            out = np.tile(center, (n, 1))
            sse = np.full(n, np.nan)
            nonfinite = np.zeros(n, bool)
            nonconv = np.zeros(n, bool)
            stalled = np.zeros(n, bool)
            bstuck = np.zeros(n, bool)
            disagree = np.zeros(n, bool)
            bfall = np.zeros(n, bool)
            cond = np.full(n, np.nan)
            fsd = np.full((n, p), np.nan)
            worst_case = nstart * (1 + iters * (p + 5))
            calls0 = self.calls
            for i in range(n):
                if self.calls + worst_case > budget:
                    bfall[i] = True
                    continue
                rng = np.random.default_rng([seed_base, row_base + i])
                th = np.log(rng.uniform(lower, upper, size=(nstart, p)))
                lam = np.full(nstart, 1e-2)
                obs = X[i]
                F = self.fwd(th)
                r = (obs - F) / sigma
                cost = (r ** 2).sum(1)
                last_step = np.zeros(nstart)
                last_dcost = np.zeros(nstart)
                last_acc = np.ones(nstart, bool)
                Jlast = None
                for it in range(iters):
                    step = np.where(th + h <= hi, h, -h)
                    pert = np.repeat(th[:, None, :], p, axis=1)
                    for j in range(p):
                        pert[:, j, j] += step[:, j]
                    Fp = self.fwd(pert.reshape(-1, p)).reshape(nstart, p, m)
                    J = (Fp - F[:, None, :]) / (step[:, :, None] * sigma)
                    Jlast = J
                    for s in range(nstart):
                        if not np.isfinite(cost[s]):
                            continue
                        Js = J[s].T
                        if not np.all(np.isfinite(Js)):
                            cost[s] = np.nan
                            continue
                        g = Js.T @ r[s]
                        H = Js.T @ Js
                        D = np.diag(np.diag(H)) + 1e-12 * np.eye(p)
                        accepted = False
                        for _ in range(5):
                            try:
                                d = np.linalg.solve(H + lam[s] * D, g)
                            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                                lam[s] *= 10.0
                                continue
                            th_new = np.clip(th[s] + d, lo, hi)
                            F_new = self.fwd(th_new)[0]
                            r_new = (obs - F_new) / sigma
                            c_new = float((r_new ** 2).sum())
                            if np.isfinite(c_new) and c_new <= cost[s]:
                                last_step[s] = float(np.abs(th_new - th[s]).max())
                                last_dcost[s] = float((cost[s] - c_new) / max(cost[s], 1e-12))
                                th[s] = th_new
                                F[s] = F_new
                                r[s] = r_new
                                cost[s] = c_new
                                lam[s] = max(lam[s] / 3.0, 1e-9)
                                accepted = True
                                break
                            lam[s] *= 4.0

                            last_step[s] = 0.0
                            last_dcost[s] = 0.0

                    continue
                best = int(np.argmin(np.where(ok, cost, np.inf)))
                kb = np.exp(th[best])
                out[i] = kb
                sse[i] = cost[best]
                nonconv[i] = bool(last_step[best] > abs_tol and last_dcost[best] > cost_tol)
                stalled[i] = bool(not last_acc[best])
                bstuck[i] = bool((np.abs(th[best] - lo) < abs_tol).any() or (np.abs(th[best] - hi) < abs_tol).any())
                others = np.exp(th[ok])
                disagree[i] = bool((np.abs(others - kb) / kb > 0.01).any())
                if Jlast is not None and np.all(np.isfinite(Jlast[best])):
                    Hb = Jlast[best] @ Jlast[best].T
                    try:
                        sv = np.linalg.svd(Hb, compute_uv=False)
                        cond[i] = float(sv.max() / max(sv.min(), 1e-300))

                    except Exception:
                        pass

                'n_rows': int(n),
                'n_obs': int(m),
                'forward_calls': int(self.calls - calls0),
                'calls_per_processed_row': float((self.calls - calls0) / max(processed, 1)),
                'n_nonfinite': int(nonfinite.sum()),
                'n_nonconverged_abs_step_and_cost': int(nonconv.sum()),
                'n_stalled_no_accepted_step_final_iter': int(stalled.sum()),
                'n_conv_not_stalled': int(((~nonconv) & (~stalled)).sum()),
                'n_conv_stalled': int(((~nonconv) & stalled).sum()),
                'n_nonconv_not_stalled': int((nonconv & (~stalled)).sum()),
                'n_nonconv_stalled': int((nonconv & stalled).sum()),
                'n_bound_stuck': int(bstuck.sum()),
                'n_budget_fallback': int(bfall.sum()),
                'frac_start_disagree_gt_1pct': float(disagree.sum() / max(processed, 1)),
                'sse_expected_chi2_df': int(80 - p),
                'chi2_76_median_ref': med76,
                'sse_mean': float(fin.mean()) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_median': float(np.median(fin)) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_p05': float(np.percentile(fin, 5)) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_p95': float(np.percentile(fin, 95)) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_max': float(fin.max()) if len(fin) else None,
                'sse_q99_threshold': q99,
                'n_sse_above_q99': int((fin > q99).sum()),
                'sse_median_bound_stuck': float(np.median(sse[bstuck & np.isfinite(sse)])) if (bstuck & np.isfinite(sse)).any() else None,
                'sse_median_not_bound_stuck': float(np.median(sse[(~bstuck) & np.isfinite(sse)])) if ((~bstuck) & np.isfinite(sse)).any() else None,
                'local_fisher_sd_logk_median_per_target': [float(np.nanmedian(fsd[:, j])) if np.isfinite(fsd[:, j]).any() else None for j in range(p)],
                'local_fisher_cond_median': float(np.nanmedian(cond)) if np.isfinite(cond).any() else None,
                'local_fisher_note': 'local sensitivity at last Jacobian of best start; not a global identifiability guarantee',
            }
            per_row = {'sse': sse, 'bound_stuck': bstuck, 'disagree': disagree, 'nonconv': nonconv, 'stalled': stalled, 'budget_fallback': bfall, 'nonfinite': nonfinite}
